reading: CoreSpace is a boutique Dallas, Texas colocation provider founded in 2009 by Liana Dunlap, who has served as founder, president, and chief executive. The company operates from a 30,000 square foot facility at 7505 John W. Carpenter Freeway with 1 megawatt of conditioned power backed by 1.5 megawatts of utility capacity and an onsite generator, running at under 30 percent utilization as of its 2025 sale listing. CoreSpace is a small operation by industry standards, serving more than 200 customers primarily in the small and midsize business segment with a team of six full-time employees and reported 2024 revenue of about 1.3 million dollars. In June 2025, asset disposition firm Hilco Streambank announced CoreSpace was for sale as a private asset transaction covering its IP addresses, trademarks, domain names, real estate, and hardware, driven by founder Liana Dunlap's retirement and the rest of leadership's decision not to continue with the company, though some employees expressed interest in staying on through a transition. No asking price was disclosed, and non-binding indications of interest were due by June 17, 2025. This registry could not confirm whether the sale has closed or identify a new owner as of the research date, so CoreSpace's ownership and operating status should be rechecked during the facility-research phase, since a completed sale would make this a former_operator situation requiring an updated operator record.
